title: Ebola Outbreak Spreads to Sixth Province in DRC
subtitle: Health officials warn the virus is moving faster than previous major epidemics as the death toll continues to climb.

summary.en: The Ebola virus has now reached a sixth province in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Officials report that the current outbreak is spreading much faster than the deadly 2014-16 epidemic. Health workers are struggling with low resources, strikes, and public misinformation. While new vaccines are being tested, experts warn the situation remains critical. The virus has already caused over 2,100 deaths across the region.
summary.zh: 伊波拉病毒目前已擴散至剛果民主共和國的第六個省份。官員指出，目前的疫情擴散速度遠快於二零一四至二零一六年間那場致命的流行病。醫護人員正苦於資源匱乏、罷工及公眾錯誤資訊的困擾。儘管新疫苗正在進行測試，專家仍警告情況依然危急。該病毒已在該地區造成超過兩千一百人死亡。

paragraphs.en: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached a new, worrying stage. According to The Guardian World, the virus has now spread to a sixth province. This news comes just one day after health leaders warned that the current situation is on track to become the deadliest Ebola outbreak in history. More than a decade ago, a major epidemic killed at least 11,000 people, and experts fear this new wave could be even worse.
paragraphs.zh: 剛果民主共和國（Democratic Republic of the Congo）的伊波拉病毒疫情已進入令人擔憂的新階段。根據《衛報》國際版報導，該病毒目前已擴散至第六個省份。就在此消息傳出前一天，衛生部門領導人曾警告，目前的疫情發展趨勢恐將成為史上最致命的伊波拉疫情。十多年前，一場重大流行病奪走了至少一萬一千人的性命，專家擔憂這波新疫情可能會更加嚴重。

paragraphs.en: Latest government figures released on Tuesday show that the virus has already caused more than 2,100 deaths out of over 4,500 recorded cases. Jean Kaseya, the director general of Africa CDC, confirmed that a death was recorded in Bas-Uele province, an area that had previously been safe. The person had traveled from a town in Haut-Uele province to the capital of Bas-Uele, where he later died. This movement of people highlights the difficulty in stopping the virus from crossing borders between provinces.
paragraphs.zh: 週二公布的最新政府數據顯示，在超過四千五百例確診病例中，該病毒已造成兩千一百多人死亡。非洲疾病管制暨預防中心（Africa CDC）總幹事卡塞亞（Jean Kaseya）證實，先前被視為安全的下韋萊省（Bas-Uele）出現了死亡病例。該名患者從上韋萊省（Haut-Uele）的一個城鎮前往下韋萊省首府，隨後在那裡過世。人員的流動凸顯了要阻止病毒跨省傳播的困難。

paragraphs.en: The speed of this outbreak is particularly concerning. The death toll has been reached almost three times faster than during the 2014-16 outbreak in west Africa, which was previously the most dangerous on record. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, the director general of the World Health Organization, noted that based on the current pace, this outbreak will likely surpass that previous record. Currently, six of the DRC’s 26 provinces are affected, with the majority of cases located in Ituri province, where the virus was first identified.
paragraphs.zh: 此次疫情的擴散速度尤其令人憂心。死亡人數攀升的速度，比二零一四至二零一六年西非那場史上最危險的疫情快了近三倍。世界衛生組織（World Health Organization）秘書長譚德塞（Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus）指出，依據目前的傳播速度，這場疫情很可能會超越先前的紀錄。目前剛果民主共和國二十六個省份中，已有六個省份受到影響，其中多數病例集中在病毒最初被發現的伊圖里省（Ituri）。

paragraphs.en: Health officials are facing many challenges in their fight against the disease. The outbreak is happening at the same time as strikes by unpaid health workers, cuts to global aid, and threats from rebel groups. In some areas, there is also anger from local communities and misinformation claiming that Ebola is not real. For example, health workers at the Nizi treatment centre in Ituri recently went on strike because they had not been paid for three months, which forced the centre to close temporarily. Additionally, health authorities report that 60% to 70% of new cases are coming from outside of the groups being monitored, which suggests the virus is spreading at an alarming rate.
paragraphs.zh: 衛生官員在對抗疾病的過程中面臨諸多挑戰。疫情爆發的同時，正值未領薪資的醫護人員發動罷工、全球援助經費遭到削減，以及反抗軍團體的威脅。在某些地區，當地社區甚至出現憤怒情緒，並流傳著伊波拉病毒並非真實存在的錯誤資訊。例如，位於伊圖里的尼齊（Nizi）治療中心醫護人員近期因三個月未領薪資而發動罷工，導致該中心被迫暫時關閉。此外，衛生當局報告指出，百分之六十至七十的新增病例來自監控名單之外，這顯示病毒正以驚人的速度擴散。

paragraphs.en: Dr. Mohamed Yakub Janabi, the regional director for Africa, described the difficult situation by saying that health teams are currently "chasing the virus" and that the virus is staying ahead of them. However, there is some hope for the future. Abdirahman Mahamud, the head of the emergency response division, suggested that if the response is managed well across all five transmission zones, there could be a turnaround in three months. Even with this positive outlook, he warned that the peak of the outbreak might not be reached for another six months, and the entire situation could last for up to a year.
paragraphs.zh: 非洲區域主任賈納比（Mohamed Yakub Janabi）博士在描述困境時表示，醫療團隊目前是在「追趕病毒」，而病毒的傳播速度始終領先於他們。不過，未來仍有一線希望。緊急應變部門負責人馬哈穆德（Abdirahman Mahamud）認為，若能妥善管理所有五個傳播區的應對措施，疫情或許能在三個月內出現轉機。儘管有此樂觀看法，他也警告疫情高峰可能在六個月後才會出現，整體情況恐將持續長達一年。

paragraphs.en: Ebola is a rare but highly contagious disease. It spreads through contact with body fluids—such as blood, vomit, or semen—from infected people or their bodies after death. It can also spread through contaminated items like clothing or bedding. Because the current outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain of the virus, there are no approved vaccines or treatments yet. However, clinical trials for two potential treatments began last month in Ituri. Furthermore, Tedros confirmed that two vaccines developed specifically for this strain are now being tested on people for the first time.
paragraphs.zh: 伊波拉是一種罕見但傳染性極高的疾病。它透過接觸感染者或死者的體液（如血液、嘔吐物或精液）傳播，亦可透過受污染的物品（如衣物或寢具）傳播。由於此次疫情涉及的是邦迪布焦（Bundibugyo）病毒株，目前尚無核准的疫苗或治療方法。不過，兩種潛在治療方式的臨床試驗已於上個月在伊圖里展開。此外，譚德塞證實，兩種專為此病毒株研發的疫苗，目前正首次進行人體測試。

paragraphs.en: While the situation inside the DRC is severe, neighboring countries are also on alert. Uganda has reported 20 cases, all located in its capital, Kampala. Fortunately, the last case there was reported on June 21, and there has been no sign of the virus spreading within the community since then. As health teams continue their work, the true scope of the outbreak remains unknown. Although the outbreak was officially declared on May 15, recent data shows that it likely began months earlier in February. With the virus continuing to move into new areas, the coming months will be a critical test for international health efforts.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管剛果民主共和國境內的情況嚴峻，鄰國也保持高度警戒。烏干達已通報二十起病例，皆位於首都坎帕拉（Kampala）。幸運的是，當地最後一起病例通報於六月二十一日，自那之後並未出現病毒在社區內傳播的跡象。隨著醫療團隊持續工作，疫情的真實規模仍是未知數。雖然疫情於五月十五日正式宣布爆發，但近期數據顯示，疫情很可能早在幾個月前的二月就已開始。隨著病毒持續向新地區擴散，未來幾個月將是國際衛生工作面臨的關鍵考驗。

keyTerms.definitionEn: Likely to achieve a particular result or happen in a particular way.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 進展順利、照預期發展（通常指朝著某個結果邁進）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 字面意思容易聯想到火車軌道，這裡指疫情發展的趨勢。文中：This news comes just one day after health leaders warned that the current situation is on track to become the deadliest Ebola outbreak in history.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A complete change from a bad situation to a good one.
keyTerms.noteZh: 由動詞片語 turn around 演變而來的名詞，指情況的逆轉。文中：Abdirahman Mahamud, the head of the emergency response division, suggested that if the response is managed well across all five transmission zones, there could be a turnaround in three months.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Prepared to deal with a dangerous situation or emergency.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 處於警戒狀態、提高警覺。
keyTerms.noteZh: 形容詞片語，用來描述面對潛在威脅時的準備狀態。文中：While the situation inside the DRC is severe, neighboring countries are also on alert.

previousArticles.title: Ebola Outbreak in the DRC Reaches Critical Levels
previousArticles.summaryEn: A serious Ebola outbreak is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Health experts warn that this could soon become the largest epidemic in history. Authorities are now working to start a large clinical trial for a vaccine. This study aims to test if a known vaccine can protect people from this specific type of the virus. Officials hope these efforts will help save lives and stop the disease from spreading further.

quiz.question: What is the primary reason for the temporary closure of the Nizi treatment centre mentioned in the text?

options.A: A lack of medical supplies and vaccines.
options.B: The staff went on strike due to unpaid wages.
options.C: The centre was attacked by local rebel groups.
options.D: The facility was overwhelmed by a sudden surge of patients.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第四段，文中明確提到 Nizi 治療中心的醫護人員因為三個月沒領到薪水而罷工，導致中心被迫暫時關閉。選項 A 雖然文中提到缺乏疫苗，但並非導致該中心關閉的主因。選項 C 雖提到有叛軍威脅，但並非該中心關閉的直接原因。選項 D 是常見的推論錯誤，文中並未指出是因為病患過多而關閉。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, why is the current outbreak considered particularly difficult to contain?

options.A: Because the virus is spreading exclusively through contaminated clothing.
options.B: Because it has already spread to all 26 provinces of the DRC.
options.C: Because a large percentage of new cases are occurring outside of monitored groups.
options.D: Because the government has officially declared the outbreak to be over.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。第四段提到 60% 到 70% 的新病例來自監控名單之外，這意味著衛生當局無法掌握病毒的傳播路徑，因此難以控制。選項 A 錯誤，因為病毒主要透過體液傳播，衣物僅是媒介之一。選項 B 錯誤，文章指出目前僅 6 個省份受影響，而非 26 個。選項 D 與事實相反，疫情仍在持續且情況嚴峻。

quiz.question: In the fifth paragraph, what does Dr. Mohamed Yakub Janabi mean when he says health teams are 'chasing the virus'?

options.A: The teams are successfully eliminating the virus from all affected areas.
options.B: The virus is spreading faster than the teams can track or respond to it.
options.C: The teams are following the virus to study its origin in the forest.
options.D: The teams are physically running after infected patients to catch them.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。這是一個隱喻用法，意指病毒的擴散速度超前於醫療團隊的反應速度，導致團隊總是處於被動追趕的狀態。選項 A 與文意相反，因為團隊落後於病毒。選項 C 錯誤，這不是為了研究起源，而是為了控制疫情。選項 D 將隱喻誤解為字面意思，是不正確的解讀方式。

quiz.question: What is the central message of the article regarding the Ebola outbreak in the DRC?

options.A: The outbreak is largely under control thanks to new vaccines and treatments.
options.B: The situation is critical due to rapid spread, logistical challenges, and the lack of established treatments.
options.C: The outbreak is less severe than the 2014-16 West African epidemic.
options.D: The virus is mainly a problem for neighboring countries like Uganda, not the DRC.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。全文綜合討論了病毒擴散速度快、多重挑戰（罷工、資金、誤解）、醫療資源不足（無核准疫苗）以及疫情可能超越歷史紀錄的嚴重性，這正是文章的核心主旨。選項 A 過於樂觀，與文意不符。選項 C 錯誤，文章反而暗示這次疫情可能比過去更糟。選項 D 錯誤，疫情的震央與主要影響範圍仍在 DRC 內部。
